portfolio_summary.description: Federal student loan portfolio outstanding (principal + interest, $ billions) and recipients (millions) by program: Direct Loans, FFEL, Perkins and Total (unduplicated recipients); one row per federal fiscal year (FY2007-2012) or fiscal-year quarter (FY2013 Q1 on) and program. Quarterly.

portfolio_by_loan_status.description: Portfolio by loan status (in-school, grace, repayment, deferment, forbearance, cumulative in default, other): $ billions outstanding and recipients (millions) by fiscal-year quarter. Sheet: Direct Loan (default, FY2013 Q3 on), FFEL (all FFEL, FY2013 Q3 on), ED-Held FFEL (FY2016 on), Federally Managed (Direct Loans + ED-held FFEL, FY2016 Q4 on). Quarterly.

sheet.desc: Direct Loan (default), FFEL, ED-Held FFEL or Federally Managed

portfolio_by_loan_type.description: Portfolio by loan type, all programs (Stafford subsidized, unsubsidized, combined with unique recipients; Grad PLUS; Parent PLUS; Perkins; Consolidation): $ billions and recipients (millions) by fiscal-year quarter, FY2014 Q2 on. Quarterly.

portfolio_by_delinquency.description: Loans in repayment status by days delinquent (current, 31-90, 91-180, 181-270, 271-360, transferring to DMCS): $ billions and recipients (millions) by fiscal-year quarter. Sheet: DLPortfoliobyDelinquencyStatus (Direct Loans, default, FY2013 Q3 on), ED-HeldFFELbyDelinquencyStatus, FedManagedPortbyDelinquencyStat. Quarterly.

portfolio_by_repayment_plan.description: Loans in repayment, deferment and forbearance by repayment plan (level, graduated, income-contingent, income-based, PAYE, SAVE, alternative, other; ED-held FFEL: income-sensitive): $ billions and recipients (millions) by fiscal-year quarter. Sheet: DLPortfoliobyRepaymentPlan (default), DL-IDRbyPFH, ED-HeldFFELbyRepaymentPlan, ED-HeldFFEL-IDRbyPFH, FedManagedPortbyRepaymentPlan, FedManaged-IDRbyPFH (IDR plans by partial financial hardship). Quarterly.

sheet.desc: DLPortfoliobyRepaymentPlan (default), DL-IDRbyPFH, ED-HeldFFELbyRepaymentPlan, ED-HeldFFEL-IDRbyPFH, FedManagedPortbyRepaymentPlan or FedManaged-IDRbyPFH

portfolio_by_location.description: Outstanding balance ($ billions) and borrowers (thousands) by borrower state of residence (plus Other, Not Reported), all programs, latest quarter only (as_of column; FFEL/Perkins borrowers of commercial lenders mostly Not Reported). Updated quarterly with a lag.

portfolio_by_age.description: Outstanding balance ($ billions) and borrowers (millions) by borrower age band (24 and younger, 25-34, 35-49, 50-61, 62 and older, not reported), all programs, by fiscal-year quarter from FY2017 Q2. Updated quarterly with a lag.

portfolio_by_debt_size.description: Outstanding balance ($ billions) and borrowers (millions) by the borrower's total federal loan balance (less than $5K ... $200K+), all programs, by fiscal-year quarter from FY2017 Q2. Updated quarterly with a lag.

dl_volume_by_school.description: Direct Loan volume by school for one award year (July 1-June 30) and award-year quarter: recipients, loans originated (count, $) and disbursements (count, $) by school (OPE ID, name, state, ZIP, type) and loan program (subsidized, unsubsidized undergraduate and graduate, Parent PLUS, Grad PLUS). Sheet Award Year Summary (default: cumulative through the quarter) or Quarterly Activity. Award years 2018-19 on (file names verified 2026-10).

award_year.desc: award year, e.g. 2025-26 (July 1, 2025 - June 30, 2026); 2018-19 or later

quarter.desc: award-year quarter 1-4 (1 = Jul-Sep, 4 = Apr-Jun); 4 holds the whole year

sheet.desc: Award Year Summary (default, cumulative) or Quarterly Activity

state.desc: two-letter state code(s) to keep (school location); foreign schools have none

school.desc: keep schools whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

grant_volume_by_school.description: Grant volume by school for one award year and award-year quarter: recipients and disbursements ($) by school and program (Federal Pell Grant, TEACH; Iraq Afghanistan Service Grant in older years). Sheet Award Year Summary (default, cumulative) or Quarterly Activity. Award years 2018-19 on.

award_year.desc: award year, e.g. 2024-25; 2018-19 or later (the file name uses the short form ay24-25)

quarter.desc: award-year quarter 1-4 (1 = Jul-Sep, 4 = Apr-Jun); 4 holds the whole year

sheet.desc: Award Year Summary (default, cumulative) or Quarterly Activity

state.desc: two-letter state code(s) to keep (school location)

school.desc: keep schools whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)
